# La maréa

> Luxury coastal wellness retreats on the Fleurieu Peninsula, South Australia. La maréa curates 8 hour immersive full day retreats for private groups and corporate teams, bringing together movement, recovery, Mediterranean-inspired food and lifestyle wellness education at partner venues on the coast and in the vineyards south of Adelaide.

La maréa is a family owned business originating from the Fleurieu Peninsula. It was founded by Belle Redden (Annabelle Redden), a performance nutritionist and exercise scientist (B.Ex.S., B.Nut.Food Sci.). Its brand line is "luxury coastal wellness reimagined". The name comes from the Spanish "la marea", meaning the tide.

Sessions are delivered by qualified health and wellness practitioners in South Australia. The retreats are grounded in ten evidence-based pillars: nutrition, movement, sleep and recovery, psychological wellbeing, nature immersion, connection, balance, personalisation, evidence-based lifestyle wellness education, and luxury and heartfelt hospitality.

## Who it is for

- Private groups: birthdays, milestone celebrations, sister weekends, family resets or time with people who matter.
- Corporate teams: a strategic reset for leadership teams and high-performing professionals.
- Children under 16 are not catered for.

## An example day

The published example is a day at Beresford Estate, McLaren Vale, for 12 guests. A private transfer collects the group in Adelaide at 7am and arrives at 8am. The morning holds a yoga or mat pilates session, a wholefood seasonal breakfast, guided breathwork, meditation and nervous system regulation, then a rotation of massage, contrast therapy (sauna, breathwork and cold plunge) and a lifestyle wellness workshop. A shared chef curated Mediterranean lunch follows, then unstructured recovery time, a closing reflection with wellness gift bags, and the transfer back to Adelaide by 5pm. La maréa can curate a personalised retreat to suit each group.

Food is plant-forward and Mediterranean-inspired, using local, seasonal and organic produce where possible, and dietary requirements are catered for. Transport from Adelaide is included. Prices are not published on the site.

## Places to Pause

- Naiko Deep Creek: on the coast at Deep Creek, about 90 minutes from Adelaide. Sleeps 6.
- Naiko at the Bluff: on the coast at Encounter Bay, Victor Harbor. Sleeps 10.
- Beresford Estate: a 70 acre vineyard in Blewitt Springs, McLaren Vale.

McLaren Vale is about 50 minutes from Adelaide. Transfers from Adelaide Airport to the Fleurieu Peninsula typically take 90 to 120 minutes, depending on traffic and time of day.

## How to enquire

Enquiries start with "Plan your day", a short set of questions about the group, followed by a discovery call with Belle.

- [Plan your day](https://www.lamarea.com.au/enquire)
- Email: info@lamarea.com.au or belle@lamarea.com.au
- Instagram: [@lamarea_retreats](https://www.instagram.com/lamarea_retreats)
